title: Reject impossible specimen stability history dates
prompt:
Fix calendar validation in lib/ohworks-stability-window.ts only. Evidence: collection, result and history timestamps are accepted solely through finite Date.parse results at lines 258-281. JavaScript normalizes February 30. I reproduced collectedAt='2026-02-30T08:00:00.000Z', a room-temp history entry at that same invalid timestamp, resultAt='2026-03-02T09:00:00.000Z', and a two-hour window returning status='within-window'. This gives a favorable specimen-integrity status despite invalid collection evidence. The rendered demo view imports this evaluator at lib/ohworks-demo-specimen-integrity-view.ts:1-4.

Validate the calendar components of each supplied timestamp before using its parsed instant. Preserve supported explicit timezone offsets and valid leap days; do not compare offset timestamps directly to UTC components. Return the existing expired outcome with collected-timestamp-invalid, result-timestamp-invalid or entry-timestamp-invalid as appropriate. Keep chronology, segment duration and window-boundary semantics unchanged. Keep any helper private to this production file.

Add tests/ohworks/stability-calendar-validity.test.ts covering impossible collection, result and history dates independently, plus valid leap-day and offset controls. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/stability-calendar-validity.test.ts tests/ohworks/stability-window.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-specimen-integrity-view.test.ts. Planning verified the reproduction and passed the existing evaluator suite. Use fabricated specimens only. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json or auth changes. Keep the change small and work on the assigned branch you are on.
